Class EventParser

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tui.event.EventParser
public final class EventParser extends Object
Parses raw terminal input into typed Event objects.

Handles escape sequences for arrow keys, function keys, navigation keys, and mouse events (SGR extended mode).
